step-1.text: Lay the tabletop face down on a rug or the flattened box, so the good side stays scratch free.

step-2.text: Find the four holes near the corners. Twist a double ended screw into each one, about halfway, by hand.

step-3.text: Grab a leg, line it up with a screw, and spin it clockwise until it sits snug. Do the same with a second leg.

step-4.text: Now the last two legs. Hand tight is perfect. No tools needed.

step-5.text: Flip the table onto its legs. Give it a little wiggle. If a leg feels loose, give it one more turn.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: That's it. Your table is done. Go put something nice on it.
